method: Forty-seven additional heights, excluding the 81-block archive: nine from the public miner history and thirty-eight later heights (974758 to 976456) from the reference deployment's solve logs. Each mainchain header, coinbase, pool tag and gross reward verified via the public BCH API. Solve excerpts redacted to an event allowlist. The first nine were recovered from immutable BlockSniper audit logs, checked against SHA-256 sidecars and database hashes, and valued with saved production price observations. The thirty-eight later excerpts have no sidecar or database hash in this snapshot (those integrity fields are null) and are valued with the documented historical Coinbase minute-candle fallback. Software attribution comes from the operator.
